_**Agent (default)**_

The main cause is your Daily room env config is not actually loaded.

- `overcast/.env.local` is missing in your workspace (I checked and it doesn’t exist), so the app falls back to hardcoded defaults.
- In `overcast/lib/daily-config.ts`, classroom URLs come from `NEXT_PUBLIC_DAILY_ROOM_1` … `NEXT_PUBLIC_DAILY_ROOM_6`.  
- If those aren’t set, it uses fallback URLs like `https://overcast.daily.co/cohort-1`, which usually won’t be valid for your Daily account, so `daily.join()` fails in `overcast/app/components/Classroom.tsx`.
- Your `README.md` still shows `DAILY_ROOM_1` style vars in places, but the code requires the `NEXT_PUBLIC_` prefix for room URLs. That mismatch is likely what tripped setup.

### Fix
1. In `overcast/`, create env file:
   - `cp env.example .env.local`
2. Edit `.env.local` with real values:
   - `DAILY_API_KEY=...`
   - `NEXT_PUBLIC_DAILY_ROOM_1=...` through `NEXT_PUBLIC_DAILY_ROOM_6=...` (real Daily room URLs you own)
3. Restart dev server after env changes (`npm run dev`).

If you want, I can also patch the `README.md` so the env variable names are consistent everywhere and prevent this confusion again.
